instrument_scope: USDT perpetual futures only; spot and spot-perpetual carry suspended from main research
user_reference: Omofun and DAmorne style, not claimed as private strategy replication

features.clock: 5m open labels; complete bar only available after open+5min; next native bar execution
features.residual: 20-minute return minus same-time median of complete40-member population
features.volume_ratio: current5m quote volume divided by prior6bar quote-volume mean
features.flow: 2*taker_buy_quote/quote_volume-1 from actual5m archive field; unknown zero-volume flow stays unknown
features.selection: volume rank>=.9, liquidity rank>=.5; top20m return decile/residual>0/flow>0 long, bottom decile/residual<0/flow<0 short; rising direction edges, one highest volume-rank then absolute residual then symbol perbar
features.missingness: all40 exact aligned candles required; unknown features produce no entry
features.adaptation: 3minute public flow becomes archived5minute flow; crypto-only40 instead of original larger crypto/TradFi population; no positioning data synthesized

account.initial_stop: 2*14bar simple-average true-range, fixed at filled entry; reject distance>=5percent;5percent native fallback

candidates.PerpFlowFast: full1percent price-profit harvest, loss of residual or flow confirmation,60minute cap or fixedATRstop; no additions
candidates.PerpFlowFunded: same seed and risk; one half-size exit at1percent priceprofit; one addition only after actual net-positive realized profit including native fees/funding, still-current direction confirmation, added stop-risk bounded by realized profit, added stake<=half initial; maximum2entries and1partial harvest; full2percentprofit or original confirmation/time/ATR exits

limits: All existing project history is retrospective and current-deployability intersection has survivorship bias
No leader labels, copied live account, source strategy state or production service is imported
No simultaneous long and short on one pair in native Freqtrade; no full Omofun hedge/grid replication claim
Historical public-flow panel is only an economic research input; a validated current-bar feed is required before paper/live eligibility
